newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - Factors to watch - March 13.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - Factors to watch - March 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* The Composite Index closed marginally weaker, down 0.61 point to 1,249.72, on selective forced selling.
* Shangri-La Hotels rose two cents to 3.36 ringgit on speculation of Landmarks looking to sell its stake in the company. Company officials at both companies could not be reached.
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 45.79 points to 7,039.37.
* Rapid Synergy debuts on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. The precision engineering company is offering 3.07 million shares at 3.80 ringgit each.
* Gaming company Magnum posted an 18 percent increase in net profit for the year to December 31, 1996.
* Pan Malaysia Cement posted a 138 percent increase in net gains for the year to December 31, 1996.
